field_menu.doc: The field menu (M2-UI-04; docs/kb/tech/ui.md section Field menu). Rects are top-left x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference, multiples of 3 so every edge lands on a whole pixel at 1280 x 720. 'root' and 'detail' are MenuPage metrics blocks (the same keys as battle_hud.json commands); a page is as tall as its rows need (MenuPage.height_for), 'detail' up to max_rows. 'desc' holds the line about the highlighted row: at the top of the right column on the root, else 'gap' under the right page, which is as tall as its rows. canvas_layer sits under the bestiary's (64), which opens over it.
